record_title: Exact periodicity of the first two off-diagonal greedy 2-sumfree families
scientific_context: Proves exact ultimate periodicity for the first two infinite parameter families immediately beyond the previously proved diagonal g=2f for greedy strict 2-sumfree sequences: g=2f+1 and g=2f+2, for every f>=5. The result gives explicit periodic residue sets, minimal period and preperiod, periodic difference words, and densities.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The theorem is restricted to f>=5 and offsets delta=1,2 and does not settle larger offsets or the general periodicity conjecture. Raymond Queneau's 1972 paper on s-additive sequences was not inspected in full and remains the main historical originality risk; unindexed concurrent work around the September 2026 preprints is also a residual risk. Finite verification is corroborative only. No independent validation, independent audit, or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact-integer verification of the closed formula against the greedy definition for 5<=f<=300 and delta in {1,2}, together with the modular sumset identities.
